# LVGL screens rendering core state (ADR-0003, ADR-0004): an ESP-IDF component
# inside firmware/ (LVGL comes from ui/idf_component.yml), a plain static library
# in the host build.
set(GG_UI_SRCS
    src/ui.c
    src/ui_i18n.c
    src/ui_menu.c
    src/ui_sysinfo.c
    src/ui_testpattern.c
    src/ui_watchface.c
)
# Generated by tools/fonts/generate.sh.
set(GG_UI_FONTS
    fonts/gg_font_digits_28.c
    fonts/gg_font_digits_70.c
    fonts/gg_font_text_16.c
    fonts/gg_font_text_20.c
)

if(ESP_PLATFORM)
    idf_component_register(
        SRCS ${GG_UI_SRCS} ${GG_UI_FONTS}
        INCLUDE_DIRS include
        PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS src fonts
        REQUIRES core
    )
else()
    add_library(gg_ui STATIC ${GG_UI_SRCS} ${GG_UI_FONTS})
    target_include_directories(gg_ui PUBLIC include PRIVATE src fonts)
    target_link_libraries(gg_ui PUBLIC gg_core lvgl::lvgl)
    target_link_libraries(gg_ui PRIVATE gg_warnings)
    set_source_files_properties(${GG_UI_FONTS} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")
endif()
